facts.fact: Paratus Namibia announced on 25 July 2022 that its carrier-neutral Armada data centre in Windhoek opens in August 2022, offering colocation (half-cabinets to cages) to clients, described as a Tier III equivalent design with 2 MW in phase 2 (operator's description, no certification stated).

note: Tier III equivalent is the operator's design claim for a facility not yet open at the time, so no tier3 fact.
